name: sim02
description: Borrowing simulation: does a statewide support at epsilon 0.01 recover a known population of PUMA 4701502 (race x income, rare groups) better than a fit on the PUMA's own PUMS sample? Truths from tn01_gpu (local) and tn04_poola_e0.01 (borrowed, the PUMA's records plus pool A); a 1-in-8 survey of each and a simulated PUMS subsample of the survey; each fitted on its PUMS alone and on its PUMS plus pool B.
